name: Conversation Café
deliverable: Structured four-round dialogue suppressing cross-talk on contentious issues

steps.text: State one contentious question and set four rounds: three where only the person holding the object speaks, one open.
Place an object in the center and pass it around; each person speaks once per round while others listen.
Forbid cross-talk in the first three rounds: no rebuttals, side conversations, or advice.
In round four, open the floor for genuine dialogue, but keep the listening rules visible.
Close by asking what each person heard that shifted or deepened their view.

failure: Cross-talk creeps in, two people debate each other, and the quiet members stop speaking before the later rounds.
intervention: Hold up the talking object and say: "No replies yet. We are here to understand, not to win; the debate round comes later."
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
